categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in the textile industry, focusing on nylon and polyester filament yarns, processed yarns, and environmentally friendly fibers including cellulose fibers. It also engages in manufacturing related to non-woven fabrics, rope and net manufacturing, pulp production, and retail and wholesale of textiles, apparel, machinery, and precision instruments. Additionally, it has subsidiaries involved in environmental materials technology and biotechnology.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced spinning technologies for nylon and polyester fibers, including development of nylon 56 fiber with anti-static properties and high moisture absorption. It employs solvent spinning for cellulose fibers (Lyocell) with eco-friendly processes and is developing new ionic liquid solvents to replace traditional NMMO solvents. The company also focuses on recycled and bio-based materials, functional fibers such as anti-static, flame retardant, and temperature-regulating yarns, and integrates smart manufacturing systems (EMS) for production efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international textile manufacturers, brand owners, and trading companies. The company serves markets in Taiwan and exports to regions including Hong Kong, China, Europe, the Americas, Asia, the Middle East, and North Africa. End markets span apparel, industrial textiles, medical textiles, and functional textile applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover Taiwan (with multiple manufacturing plants in Changhua and Yunlin counties) and international markets across Asia, Europe, the Americas, Middle East, and North Africa. The company maintains a balanced domestic and export sales ratio of approximately 50:50.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the textile supply chain, producing raw and processed synthetic fibers and environmentally friendly fibers that serve downstream textile manufacturers and brand customers. It also has upstream involvement through pulp production and downstream activities via retail and wholesale of textile-related products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing product quality, expanding high value-added and environmentally sustainable products, and strengthening R&D capabilities. Key R&D initiatives focus on developing functional fibers such as high-absorption Lyocell, elastic nylon, anti-static and flame retardant yarns, and innovative recycled materials. The company also emphasizes digital transformation, smart manufacturing, and compliance with evolving environmental regulations like the EU Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR).
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of synthetic and environmentally friendly fibers, processed yarns, and related textile products. The company also derives income from its subsidiaries and investments. There is no indication of subscription or licensing revenue models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as one of the top nylon filament and processed yarn manufacturers in Taiwan, with a strong R&D foundation and focus on high value-added and eco-friendly products. It faces competition from lower-cost manufacturers in China and Southeast Asia and must continuously innovate to maintain competitiveness amid tariff and geopolitical challenges.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$2.94 billion, a 19.94% increase from the prior year, and a net profit attributable to owners of NT$16 million, recovering from a prior loss. The company has shown improving profitability and stable asset base with total assets around NT$3.45 billion. R&D expenditure increased slightly to about NT$49 million, supporting growth and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, functional, and environmentally sustainable fibers that meet evolving market demands for comfort, performance, and eco-friendliness. Its unique value lies in advanced fiber technologies such as biodegradable Lyocell, flame retardant PET yarns, and cost-effective anti-static fibers. Integration of smart manufacturing and commitment to sustainability further differentiate its products and services.
